G3D (idx 5) / G3DL2 (idx 6): rates_khz = the fvmap rows OBSERVED in run g0b (docs/research/27; dt gs101-gpu.dtsi:46-47 gpu0_cmu_cal_id = ACPM_DVFS_G3DL2, gpu1 = ACPM_DVFS_G3D), ceiling_khz G3D 762000 / G3DL2 996000 = DT v2 pair row 1 (gs101-gpu.dtsi:55-90) = the stock maximum (gs101-gpu.dtsi:94 gpu_dvfs_max_freq), raised from row 3 (T-50eb) by sprint-gpu 2026-11-08 (pinned in tools/boards.py _GPU_DVFS_CEIL), so the client refuses every rate above it (--gpu-clk only; the CPU --dvfs requests never use them; the 151000 kHz init level stays a row below the ceiling). Was 151000 before T-a214. slc (SWEET PROBE, patch 0363, docs/research/161 s.1): the SLC service channel. ch_id 10 = DT node slc-acpm acpm-ipc-channel = 0x0a and async_ch_id 11 = its child node async acpm-ipc-channel = 0x0b [obs stock device tree capture, research 161 s.1.1]; pt_version 0xd005 = PT_VERSION and known_major 1 = PT_VERSION_KNOWN [src SG kernel/google-modules/soc/gs @ 20407875 drivers/soc/google/pt/slc_acpm.c:29-36, :160-195]. Read-only use only: shim/acpm.c acpm_slc_describe (descriptor of ch 10 and 11, reads) and acpm_slc_version (ONE fixed PT_VERSION request on ch 10); every other SLC opcode (0xd001-0xd004 enable/disable/mutate/check, PMON, trace) is not expressible. notes.s2mpg11: READ-ONLY S2MPG11 (sub PMIC, the GPU rails BUCK2S = S2S_VDD_G3D, BUCK8S = S8S_VDD_G3D_L2, LDO1S = L1S_VDD_G3D_M) registers for --gpu-rails (shim/gpurails.c, docs/research/27), read through the S2MPG10 railsr request path (acpm.c acpm_s11_read: same IPC channel 2, FUNC_READ only). Derived the same way as speedy_ch/pmic_addr 0/1 of S2MPG10 (doc 23 section 1): speedy_ch 1 = channel argument of every s2mpg11_*_reg (GK drivers/mfd/s2mpg11-core.c:55,73,91,109,127: u8 channel = 1) and DT acpm-speedy-channel = <1> (gs101-pmic.dtsi:710-718); pmic_addr 1 = I2C_ADDR_PMIC of the PM block (s2mpg11-core.c:29; the pmic dummy client). IPC channel stays 2 (acpm-ipc-channel = <2> in the same DT node). Registers (include/linux/mfd/samsung/s2mpg11-register.h:26-100): STATUS1 0x0C, B2S_CTRL 0x15 / OUT1 0x16 / OUT2 0x17, B8S_CTRL 0x25 / OUT1 0x26 / OUT2 0x27, L1S_CTRL1 0x41 / CTRL2 0x42, LDO_CTRL1 0x52. Rail descriptors (s2mpg11-regulator.c:226-275): BUCK2S/8S enable = *_CTRL mask 7:6 (S2MPG11_REG_ENABLE_MASK_7_6, register.h:335), vsel = *_OUT1, 256 steps, group 1 = 200000 uV + 6250 * sel (register.h:308-309); LDO1S enable = LDO_CTRL1 mask 5:4 (:334), vsel = L1S_CTRL1 mask 0x7F (128 steps), group 4 = 300000 uV + 12500 * sel (:314-315). Mode field: 0 off, 1 ON in standby (SEC_OPMODE_SUSPEND), 2 ON in PWREN_MIF mode, 3 ON normal (s2mpg11_of_map_mode, s2mpg11-regulator.c:35-46); DT initial mode of all three rails is SEC_OPMODE_SUSPEND (gs101-pmic.dtsi:760-773,850-860,936-946). Read on hardware 2026-10-23 (run g1rails2: BUCK2S mode 0 off, BUCK8S/LDO1S on). Which of OUT1/OUT2 is the live output is a guess (Linux reads and writes OUT1). WRITER (opt-in --gpu-rail-on, shim/gpurailon.c): rail_on = the only S2MPG11 register the shim may write, BUCK2S_CTRL (S2S_VDD_G3D, the shader rail) 0x15 (register.h:48) mask 0xC0 = the mode field bits 7:6 (S2MPG11_REG_ENABLE_MASK_7_6, register.h:335; regulator.c:259-260), val_on 0x40 = mode 1 'SUSPEND' = what LINUX writes for this rail: the DT gives BUCK2S regulator-initial-mode = SEC_OPMODE_SUSPEND (gs101-pmic.dtsi:766-779), s2mpg11_of_map_mode maps it to 1 (regulator.c:35-46), s2m_set_mode stores opmode[id] = mode << shift & mask (:48-73; the probe starts with opmode[id] = enable_mask, :718) and s2m_enable writes opmode[id] under the mask (:75-91), so the value proven on this rail in stock Android is 0x40, and a leftover 0x40 equals stock, val_off 0x00 = mode 0 = disabled (s2m_disable writes 0 under the mask, :95-111); only these two values, only under that mask (read-modify-write by the APM, FUNC_UPDATE). Allowed only when BUCK2S_CTRL reads exactly mode 0 (off, observed run g1rails2: 0x38) and out1_reg 0x16 (B2S_OUT1, observed 0x40 = 600000 uV) decodes inside min_uv..max_uv = 550000..700000 uV (fvmap G3D init level 562500 uV, run g0b; Linux DT window of the rail is 450000..1300000 uV, gs101-pmic.dtsi:766-768); the voltage registers are never written. soft_start_us 130 = S2MPG11_ENABLE_TIME_BUCK (register.h:339, the regulator core's enable_time in us); the shim waits 8x that. A null value makes the options refuse before any ACPM traffic.
